## Verdict

Critical security regression: TLS certificate verification is disabled unconditionally for every ledger HTTP client.

## Findings

| # | Severity | File | Summary |
|---|----------|------|---------|
| 1 | 🚨 critical | `internal/ledger/client.go:14` | `InsecureSkipVerify: true` applies in all environments, enabling MITM on ledger traffic |

## Notes

`NewClient()` is shared construction with no staging/prod split, env flag, or custom CA pool. A comment and TICKET-77 do not constrain runtime behavior. Production (or any non-staging) callers inherit the same insecure transport.

Preferred fix: pin the staging CA (or use a staging-only build tag / config flag that installs `RootCAs`), and keep verification enabled everywhere else. If a temporary skip is unavoidable, gate it explicitly on an explicit staging environment check that defaults to secure.

**Recommendation:** request-changes
